title: Credits on Conversion to Repair: Terms Table for Repair Estimates & Appointments
content:
Some Repair Estimates & Appointments estimate-stage charges are waived when the booking converts to a repair order inside the conversion credit window. The window and the charges it reaches are set per estimate type.

| Estimate type | Conversion credit window (calendar days after the estimate written date) | Teardown fee credited | Scan fee credited | Measurement fee credited | Tow-in charge credited |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | 0 | No | No | No | No |
| Drive-In Estimate | 0 | No | No | No | No |
| Scheduled Estimate | 14 | No | Yes | No | No |
| Mobile Estimate | 0 | No | No | No | No |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 14 | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 21 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

- **Conversion credit window** — the calendar days after the estimate written date within which a conversion earns the estimate-fee credits; 0 means no credit.
- **Teardown / scan / measurement fee credited** — whether that fee is waived when the booking converts inside the conversion credit window.
- **Tow-in charge credited** — whether the tow-in charge is waived when the booking converts inside the conversion credit window.

Reading the table: the Photo, Drive-In and Mobile Estimates have a 0-day window and earn no credit; the Scheduled Estimate and the Blueprint Teardown Estimate have 14 days; the Structural Blueprint Estimate has 21 days.
